summary: Core financial claims (revenue, margins, FCF, SBC, share count, short interest, insider ownership, peer multiples, analyst targets, returns) are all verified against yfinance primary data. Key VERIFIED_WITH_NOTE items: (1) Net cash $419mn uses GS debt-only convention excluding $49mn capital leases; yfinance including leases gives $393mn — both correct under different accounting conventions; (2) EBITDA $67.7mn in snapshot is GS-format operating EBITDA vs yfinance GAAP $11.4mn — the snapshot label 'GAAP' is technically inaccurate, as GAAP EBITDA per yfinance is $11.4mn; the $67.7mn is operating EBITDA (EBIT $45.1mn + D&A $22.6mn). One MISMATCH: ADTV $57mn is the GS April 1, 2026 figure; current (June 9, 2026) 3-month ADTV is $46mn. Several ASP figures, reimbursement rates, clinical data points, and market share estimates are cited from the GS initiation report and are unverifiable via yfinance — these are standard sell-side disclosures and are appropriately treated as company/GS data. Valuation math is fully reproducible. Overall verdict: PASS_WITH_NOTES; three items warrant minor correction (EBITDA label in snapshot, ADTV currency, net cash convention disclosure).
